description: Trigger evals for extract-foundations-from-screens: it fires when many written screen docs hold raw values that should be merged into role tokens, while foundation-audit, screen-spec, design-spec-review, component-spec and color-contrast-architect handle drift checks on curated foundations, writing a screen doc, checking built code against its spec, one component, and contrast pairs.

should_trigger: I have 22 SCREEN_SPEC files under design/screens with hex codes and px values all over the place. Consolidate them into foundations for color and typography.
merge the raw values from our screen docs into role tokens, and don't touch the ones we already named in foundations/color.md
We ran this last week on 12 screens. Six more got documented since then, so run it again and only add what's new. Anything that clashes should go to a review list, not get overwritten.
Across the SCREEN_SPEC files I see 6px, 10px and 14px gaps next to the 4px grid steps. Build the spacing and radii scale from them and flag the off-grid ones instead of rounding.
screen docs are done, foundations folder is empty, can you derive the tokens from them

should_not_trigger.prompt: The foundations docs are curated and every screen already uses role tokens. I just want to know if the code theme file still matches them.
The Settings screen is built now. Check whether the code actually uses the colors and spacing its screen spec lists, and whether every state in the spec is implemented.
Only two screens have docs so far. The profile screen has a Figma frame but no doc; write that one before we try to pull any tokens out of the screen docs.
Document the primary button from Figma with its variants, sizes, states and accessibility notes.
Check whether the contrast between our text and surface colors passes AA in both themes before we lock the palette.
